m403-house-outside.observed_description: A suburban street from across the road: a brick garden wall on the left, a house with a gray tiled roof and a ginger cat on the ridge, a front lawn with a golden dog standing in it, and a tall modern apartment building with balconies on the right. No people.
m403-house-outside.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The cat is small; its target covers the roof.
